【Camera Composition】
Cinematic extreme long shot, bird's eye view, wide-angle lens, rule of thirds composition, horizon line positioned at upper third of frame, creating epic grandeur

【Video Atmosphere】
Primeval ancient era, overcast dark sky, thick clouds, cold color palette (cyan-gray + earthy yellow), dim lighting with rich layers, creating primitive, harsh, oppressive survival atmosphere, 8k cinematic quality, dramatic chiaroscuro

【Action Sequence】
0-2s: Camera slowly descends from high altitude, revealing the full expanse of the barren wilderness, jagged rocks, sparse vegetation, distant beast pack barely visible
2-3.5s: Camera focuses, Human Ancestor (young) running and fleeing through the wilderness, bare-chested, animal skin clothing fluttering, defined muscle lines, determined eyes
3.5-5s: Predatory beast pack (wolf, tiger, leopard forms) closing in from all directions, eyes glowing with ferocity, drooling from mouths, forming an encirclement

【Audio Design】
Ambient: Deep beast growls (continuous), howling wind (background), running footsteps (Human Ancestor)
Music: Low-pitched tense orchestral score, gradually intensifying rhythm
Voiceover (Chinese Mandarin, male voice, deep and weathered accent): "传说，这个世界刚刚形成的时候，一片蛮荒，野兽横行..."

两只可爱的卡通柴犬坐在复古播客录音棚里当主播，暖黄色的复古台灯照明，桌上有两个专业麦克风、耳机、彩色pop filter和两杯冒着热气的咖啡，背景是深色吸音棉墙+几张专辑封面海报，氛围轻松幽默

镜头1：镜头慢慢推近，两只柴犬戴着耳机，一只棕色柴犬表情夸张疲惫，歪着头对着麦克风，用很夸张的语气说：
“主人今天说她累成狗了……”

镜头立刻切到另一只浅黄色柴犬，它一脸震惊+无语的表情，停顿0.5秒后，用超级认真的语气怼回去：
“她是不是对‘狗’这个物种有什么严重误解？我今天在家睡了整整16个小时，醒了就吃，吃完继续玩，生活简直不要太爽！”

最后一镜：两只柴犬同时爆笑，身体前仰后合，嘴巴张得超大，露出尖尖的小虎牙，眼角都笑出泪花，尾巴疯狂摇动，麦克风差点被撞倒，咖啡杯晃出几滴咖啡，画面充满喜感

画面风格：明亮温暖的日系治愈风+轻微美式卡通夸张表情，色彩饱和度适中，动作流畅自然，毛发细节丰富，拟人化但保留狗狗特征，60fps超丝滑，电影感运镜，轻微的呼吸灯呼吸光效，整体幽默又可爱，结尾可稍微慢动作定格在爆笑瞬间

inputs.text: A medium close-up shot features a Caucasian man with a closely shaven head and face, wearing a black baseball cap with "PNTR" in white letters on the front, and a dark grey t-shirt with "JUST DO IT" visible across his chest. A small black microphone is clipped to his shirt collar. He is positioned slightly to the left of the frame, looking intently downwards and to his right, his eyes focused off-camera. His facial expression is one of deep concentration, with his brow slightly furrowed. As he looks down, a quick sniff sound is heard, and then he speaks with a deep male voice and a slightly frustrated tone, saying, "I think it's so bad." The camera remains static throughout, maintaining a shallow depth of field, which keeps the man in sharp focus while the background is softly blurred, revealing a light-colored wall with white wooden shelving or trim, and a partially open white wooden door on the right. After a brief pause, another short, audible sniff is heard. The man then continues to speak, his voice maintaining the same quality, as he states, "So bad. So bad." He elaborates further, emphasizing his point with a final statement, "This got to be, it's got to be the worst tool I've ever seen."
